# FootPlacement

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FootPlacement")`

Places a character's feet on the ground under them, such as a stair, a slope or a rock, and lowers the hips to match. Walk animations are made for flat ground; this adapts them to uneven ground.

Parent it to the skinned `MeshPart` and set the two ankle joints and the hips joint. Every frame, a ray cast down from each foot finds the ground. The foot is moved onto it, keeping the height the animation had lifted it to, and the knee bends to fit.

It is visual only: each machine computes it for the pose it draws, and simulation code does not see it. It applies only to characters near the camera, at a distance set by the graphics settings, and not at all at the lowest quality level or for the agents of a `Swarm`. It costs two raycasts per character per frame.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AlignToSlope` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a planted foot is rotated to lie flat on the ground under it. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the placement is applied. |
| `FootHeight` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | The distance from the ankle joint down to the sole, in meters. The ankle is kept this far above the ground. |
| `Hips` | `string` | — | read/write | The name of the joint both legs hang from. It is lowered when one foot is below the ground level the animation assumes. |
| `LeftFoot` | `string` | — | read/write | The name of the left ankle joint, as it is named in the model file. |
| `RightFoot` | `string` | — | read/write | The name of the right ankle joint, as it is named in the model file. |
| `StepHeight` | `number` | `0.4` | read/write | The largest distance, in meters, that a foot is moved up or down from where the animation put it. Ground farther away than that, such as a ledge or a drop, is ignored. |
| `Weight` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How strongly the placement is applied, from 0 to 1. |
